Where we work

Two of the region's most-watched addresses

Both corridors sit inside the master-planned growth belt of the National Capital Region.

SECTORS & SOCIETIES

Greater Noida

A planned city with wide roads, established schools and hospitals, and steady demand from the Delhi-NCR workforce.

  • Connected to Noida, Delhi and the Yamuna Expressway
  • Established residential sectors alongside newer developments
  • Close to institutional, retail and healthcare infrastructure
GROWTH CORRIDOR

Yamuna Expressway

The stretch drawing the most attention in the NCR right now, anchored by the upcoming international airport at Jewar.

  • Direct expressway access toward Agra and Delhi
  • Proximity to Noida International Airport, Jewar
  • Strong long-term potential for plots and commercial space
